"text": "This soft, layered look is perfect for walking to your office on a snowy autumn day. The ivory knit trousers give you the freedom of movement you need for a long walk, while the knitted cardigan and viscose top add a cozy warmth that complements your skin tone beautifully. To protect yourself from the cold without sacrificing style, I've chosen the beige quilted jacket as your essential outer layer; it provides the necessary insulation against -15°C while maintaining a sleek silhouette. The matching beige scarf wraps around your neck to add extra warmth and ties the entire neutral palette together seamlessly.",
"how_to_wear": [ "Tuck the knitted cardigan slightly into your ivory trousers at the front for a cleaner, more polished line that suits your proportions.", "When you arrive at the office, take off the quilted jacket but keep the viscose top and ivory trousers; this combination remains chic and professional throughout the day." ],

"about_items": [
{n: "#72·00", text: "This milky white viscose top features a relaxed, draped design with a distinctive ring detail at the front and a single shoulder strap that adds an elegant touch of asymmetry to your neckline."},
{n: "#189·29", text: "The grey woolen cardigan is a soft, classic piece fastened with neat buttons down the front, offering a comfortable fit that drapes gently over your frame for everyday wearability."},
{n: "#251·37", text: "This beige quilted jacket features a diamond-stitched pattern and includes a matching belt to define your silhouette, while its hood provides practical protection against snow and wind."},
{n: "#186·25", text: "The beige angora kerchief is a soft, textured accessory that adds gentle warmth around your neck and contributes a delicate, neutral tone to complement the rest of your ensemble."},
{n: "#494·03", text: "This sophisticated beige handbag combines smooth leather with suede accents and features a distinctive silver-toned clasp, offering both elegance and practicality for carrying your essentials."},
{n: "#219·13", text: "These ivory trousers have a relaxed, tapered fit that moves easily with you as you walk, providing a clean line from your waist down to your ankles without any restrictive details."},
{n: "#83·11", text: "The beige suede boots offer sturdy support and a stylish block heel, extending up your calf to keep your legs warm while adding height and structure to complete your outfit."}
]
